successors.name: County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos (Tocco)

capitals.name: Castle of Saint George (Kastro Agiou Georgiou), near Peratata, Cephalonia

ledger.x: 1185: William II of Sicily grants Cephalonia and Zakynthos to Margaritus of Brindisi for naval service (later held by the Orsini from 1195).
1357: Robert of Taranto cedes Cephalonia, Zakynthos and Ithaca to Leonardo I Tocco; the Angevins had occupied the islands after 1335 or 1325.
ledger.cpn: County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos (Tocco)

ledger.x: 1357: the Orsini county's line of rule is long over; the islands pass to the Tocco county.
ledger.cpn: County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos (Tocco)

certainty.note: The page names only the islands; no area or borders.
